financing.downPaymentPolicy: BECU confirmed Jul 27: no down payment required on purchases under $100,000. Cash savings go toward early principal payoff and closing costs, not upfront down.
financing.earlyPayoffStrategy: Model full-loan payments below; keep $6–10k liquid for tax, title, insurance, and inspection, then apply any extra savings as lump-sum principal payments.

extraCashNeeded.notes: WA sales/use tax (~8–10%), title/license, Class B insurance binder, and pre-purchase inspection. Ask BECU whether tax/fees can roll into the loan.

financing.recommendation: BECU is the lead lender: preapprove for a secured RV loan with $0 down under $100k, ≤10 model years, and ≤75k miles. Shop candidates directly (private party or dealer) — AutoSmart/CUDL shows no Solis inventory. Prefer a ≤10-year term; use any saved cash for early payoff rather than down. Compare one backup WA credit union quote.

paymentAssumptions.disclaimer: Illustrative mid-2026 planning estimates using published credit-union “as low as” ranges. Not an offer or credit decision.
